      • FraudAlert

        public FraudAlert()
        Default constructor. Note that this does not initialize fields to their default values from the schema. If that is desired then one should use newBuilder().

      • FraudAlert

        public FraudAlert​(CharSequence alertId,
                  CharSequence transactionId,
                  CharSequence customerId,
                  CharSequence cardId,
                  Long alertTimestamp,
                  AlertSeverity severity,
                  Double fraudScore,
                  AlertType alertType,
                  List<CharSequence> riskFactors,
                  CharSequence modelVersion,
                  RecommendedAction recommendedAction,
                  Map<CharSequence,​Double> features,
                  Boolean isFalsePositive)
        All-args constructor.
        Parameters:
        alertId - Unique identifier for the fraud alert
        transactionId - Reference to the suspicious transaction
        customerId - Customer identifier
        cardId - Card identifier
        alertTimestamp - Alert generation timestamp
        severity - Severity level of the fraud alert
        fraudScore - AI model fraud probability score (0.0 - 1.0)
        alertType - Type of fraud pattern detected
        riskFactors - List of risk factors contributing to the alert
        modelVersion - Version of the AI model that generated the alert
        recommendedAction - Recommended action based on fraud assessment
        features - Feature values used for model inference
        isFalsePositive - Marked as true if alert was a false positive
